method: Each supported claim requires a retrieved public page or PDF with a named passage. Title-only relevance is insufficient. Short factual extracts only; no full-text redistribution.

sources.validityPeriod: page live as retrieved; content may change without notice
sources.relevantPassage: In space, each satellite is cross-linked to four others, providing advantages in reliability and resiliency. … The Iridium constellation is in Low-Earth Orbit (LEO), approximately 780 kilometers … satellites to converge at the poles …
sources.preciseClaimSupported: Iridium publishes a LEO cross-linked constellation architecture class with high-latitude/polar coverage narrative.
sources.technicalScope: space-segment architecture (cross-links); not a named gateway inventory
sources.accessReuse: Public web page; cite URL and retrieval date; do not republish page wholesale
sources.limitations: Marketing/technical page; does not name Svalbard or Lapland serving paths; does not prove site independence.

sources.validityPeriod: States operational status as of publication; not a 2026 inventory attestation
sources.relevantPassage: The Punta Arenas site now joins existing operational Iridium commercial ground stations in Fairbanks, Alaska; Svalbard, Norway and Tempe, Arizona. … crosslinked satellite architecture …
sources.preciseClaimSupported: As of 2019-03-28 Iridium stated that Svalbard, Norway was among its operational commercial ground stations, alongside Fairbanks and Tempe; also restates cross-link architecture.
sources.geographicScope: Named stations: Fairbanks AK; Svalbard Norway; Tempe AZ; Punta Arenas Chile
sources.technicalScope: Commercial ground-station facility existence (Iridium wording); not customer-terminal routing
sources.accessReuse: Public press release; cite URL and date; short extract only
sources.limitations: Historical (2019). Does not prove 2026 status. Does not bind any Finnish Lapland terminal to Svalbard. KSAT partnership named for Punta Arenas construction — ownership/ops of Svalbard not fully specified here.

sources.validityPeriod: page live as retrieved; content may change
sources.relevantPassage: Each Starlink satellite contains 3 space lasers (Optical Intersatellite Links or ISLs) operating at up to 200 Gbps, which together across the constellation form a global internet mesh…
sources.preciseClaimSupported: Starlink publishes optical ISL / laser-mesh as a constellation architecture class.
sources.technicalScope: space-segment optical ISL; not named Nordic gateways
sources.accessReuse: Public web page; cite URL and retrieval date
sources.limitations: Automated full-page fetch returned thin body; passage confirmed via page search snippet + Progress reports. Does not name Lapland gateways or prove dual-path independence.

sources.validityPeriod: Progress report framing for 2025; not a perpetual gateway inventory
sources.relevantPassage: Starlink customers always have multiple satellites in view, as well as multiple gateway sites and internet Points of-Presence locations for the constellation to route data through.
sources.preciseClaimSupported: Starlink distinguishes gateway sites from internet Points-of-Presence as separate routing elements in its published network-resilience narrative.
sources.geographicScope: global operator narrative (no Nordic site names in cited passage)
sources.technicalScope: Entity-type distinction gateway vs PoP; not facility coordinates
sources.accessReuse: Public PDF; cite URL; short extract only
sources.limitations: Does not list Nordic gateways/PoPs. Must not be read as a Lapland serving-path map.

sources.publisher: Zhao et al. / IFIP TMA 2025 (University of Victoria affiliation in paper)
sources.validityPeriod: SNP/PoP compilation stated as of May 2025
sources.relevantPassage: Since the current OneWeb Phase 1 satellites do not utilize ISLs [18], [21], the strategic positioning of SNPs worldwide is crucial… APPENDIX ONEWEB SNPS (MAY 2025) … Europe … Norway Svalbard … Sweden Piteå … Greenland Nuuk … As of May 2025, OneWeb has 29 PoPs and 40 SNPs…
sources.preciseClaimSupported: (1) Secondary compilation that OneWeb Phase 1 lacks ISLs. (2) Secondary compilation that Nordic-region SNPs include Svalbard, Piteå, and Nuuk as of May 2025. (3) Explicit distinction SNP vs PoP.
sources.geographicScope: Compiled global SNP/PoP map; Nordic rows used for facility-existence entities only
sources.technicalScope: Ground SNP existence (compiled); bent-pipe Phase 1 architecture class
sources.accessReuse: Academic PDF; cite paper + URL; short extract; respect IFIP copyright — no full redistribution
sources.limitations: Not OneWeb primary attestation. SNP list compiled from AWS dataset + regulators per paper note. Ages after May 2025. Does not prove which SNP serves a Finnish Lapland terminal.

sources.publisher: PeeringDB (network self-published facility list for AS800 / OneWeb)
sources.validityPeriod: Peering Facility Info Updated 2026-03-26T16:34:39Z (as shown on page 2026-11-26); ASN Last Updated 2026-11-02T04:55:09Z
sources.relevantPassage: ASN 800 · Organization OneWeb · Interconnection Facilities include Digital Realty AMS17 - Amsterdam (Netherlands) and Equinix LD8 - London, Docklands (United Kingdom), among others.
sources.preciseClaimSupported: OneWeb AS800 lists European interconnection facilities (PoP-class), including Amsterdam and London Docklands, in PeeringDB.
sources.geographicScope: Listed interconnection facilities (global list; AMS and LD8 used as European examples)
sources.technicalScope: Terrestrial interconnection / PoP presence — not SNP, not gateway, not user-terminal path
sources.accessReuse: PeeringDB terms of use; cite ASN page; facility names as facts from that listing
sources.limitations: Voluntary/community DB. Facilities ≠ SNPs. Does not prove which PoP a Lapland session uses. Incomplete by nature.

sources.validityPeriod: Circular Rev.2; GMDSS/Iridium system description context
sources.relevantPassage: Teleport means a terrestrial part of the Iridium mobile-satellite system which communicates between the Iridium satellites and the gateway… Gateway means a terrestrial part of a mobile satellite system that acts as an interface between the network and other communication networks. … satellites support … satellite-to-satellite … cross-linked satellite architecture.
sources.preciseClaimSupported: In Iridium GMDSS documentation, teleport and gateway are defined as distinct ground-segment roles; cross-linked architecture is described.
sources.technicalScope: Role taxonomy teleport vs gateway; space cross-links
sources.accessReuse: Public IMO circular; cite document ID; short extract
sources.limitations: Safety-service framing may lag commercial SKU detail. Does not inventory Nordic teleports for a Lapland customer path.

sources.validityPeriod: Issued 1 November 2023; validity until further notice (per guidelines)
sources.relevantPassage: A licence … is required for the establishment and operation of an earth station and radar in Finnish territory… The scope of application of the Act does not cover the conventional use of satellite services.
sources.preciseClaimSupported: Finland requires licensing for establishing/operating earth stations (with conventional terminal use generally outside that Act’s scope).
sources.technicalScope: Regulatory regime for earth stations — not a public facility inventory
sources.limitations: Contains no published list of licensed gateway coordinates. Must not be used to invent Finnish gateways.

sources.relevantPassage: Register of licence and supervision matters related to earth station and radar operations … Location of the earth station or radar … Disclosure … between authorities …
sources.preciseClaimSupported: Traficom maintains an earth-station licence/supervision register that includes location, for official duties — not presented as open bulk data for third-party mapping.
sources.accessReuse: Public privacy notice; cite URL; do not attempt unauthorized register access
sources.limitations: Confirms data sensitivity. Explains why Finnish gateway locations remain UNKNOWN in this pack.

sources.relevantPassage: Catalogue ids starlink, oneweb, iridium with orbit/class labels used by Model v0.4.
sources.preciseClaimSupported: Catalogue classification snapshot for the research envelope (provider diversity / catalogue-based orbit mix) — not infrastructure proof.

unverifiedLeadsExcludedFromRelationships.wouldHaveSupportedIfVerified: SSC hosting/install narrative for OneWeb sites (Stockholm Teleport / Esrange mentioned in prior search).

unverifiedLeadsExcludedFromRelationships.wouldHaveSupportedIfVerified: Standalone Nordic teleport facility existence only.
